label: C / FACE Case 5

paper-64gib.label: 64 GiB paper configuration
paper-64gib.note: FACE Case 5 provides 64 GiB of local HBM per NPU in the paper configuration.

validation-160gib.label: 160 GiB validation extension
validation-160gib.note: Validation-only capacity extension for workloads that require 160 GiB of local HBM per NPU.

validation-die-64g.label: 64 GB die-derived validation capacity
validation-die-64g.note: Die-backend aligned capacity: exactly the HBM capacity derived by the die cost library from the die node (4 x 16 GB), required by config_resolver when the die node is present.

notes: The physical mesh is row-major with 9 rows and 6 columns.
The analytical network lists dimensions as columns then rows.

The die node (stage C, 2026-10-03) replaces compute.peak-perf-tflops: peak compute, local-mem bandwidth and capacity are derived by the shared die cost library (mutually exclusive with a compute node).

Die point ruling 2026-10-03: large cores / 0.75 MB SRAM / 800 mm2 / NoC 512 bit / HBM 4x1 keeps the derived bandwidth strictly continuous with the legacy 1640 GB/s; validation-die-64g mirrors the derived 64 GB capacity, the legacy paper-64gib/validation-160gib entries remain for other uses but fail the die capacity alignment.
D2D latency is modeled as a per-hop adjacent-link latency and is independent of the on-die noc-width-bits.
Remote-memory expansion is disabled for this repository configuration.
The capacity profile describes local HBM placement per NPU.
